major_issues: Mobile layout is overly tall and dense: critical info is pushed far below the fold and the right-side panels stack into a long scroll with no prioritization or collapse.

The main flow canvas/diagram is clipped/partially off-screen on mobile (left edge content cut) and starts mid-viewport; pan/zoom affordances are unclear, and the content doesn’t auto-fit to the viewport.
Top navigation/controls (tabs + Fit/zoom/percent/buttons) are cramped on mobile; labels truncate (e.g., 'Economi') and tap targets appear too small/close.
Text readability/contrast issues in several secondary lines (gray-on-dark) and tiny metadata (timestamps, host line) are borderline; hierarchy relies too much on subtle color.
medium_issues: Inconsistent spacing rhythm: cards have generous padding but internal sections (chips, metrics rows) feel cramped; vertical gaps between major sections vary.
Right column cards on desktop feel visually heavy and repetitive (same card style, similar headings); scanning is slower than necessary due to low differentiation.
Overflow handling for long strings (URLs, hostnames, blocker ids) is inconsistent: some wrap awkwardly, others risk clipping; chips can create ragged multi-line layouts.
Event strip at the bottom of the canvas is small and low-contrast; appears non-interactive and easy to miss despite being important.
Bottom 'Host / eno1 / Blocker' cards on desktop feel detached from the main grid (floating footer look) and consume height without strong utility.
minor_issues: Tab active state and focus states are subtle; keyboard focus visibility likely insufficient on dark theme.
Icon buttons (refresh/chevron/zoom) lack labels/tooltips; discoverability and accessibility suffer.
Some headings are all-caps/small caps with low contrast; reduces readability on mobile.
Card shadows/inner glows are a bit strong, creating a hazy look and reducing crispness.

recommended_changes.change: Fix mobile responsiveness for the main diagram: ensure the canvas/container uses width:100%, max-width:100vw, and initial transform fits content (auto-fit). Add overflow:auto with clear safe padding so nodes are not clipped on the left. Consider a 'Fit to screen' button always visible on mobile.

Rework header controls for small screens: use a responsive layout (flex-wrap with row gaps), increase tap targets to >=44px, and prevent tab label truncation by using shorter labels or allowing wrap/scroll. Example: make the tab bar horizontally scrollable with scroll-snap and hide zoom controls behind a compact menu on <480px.

Improve text contrast and type scale on dark theme: bump secondary text color (e.g., from ~#7a to ~#a0), increase small meta font-size (timestamps/host line/event strip) to at least 12–13px on mobile, and raise line-height for paragraphs in detail cards.

Add basic information prioritization/collapsing on mobile: collapse less-critical panels ('IDLE / STOPPED', footer host cards) behind accordions; keep 'Runtime', 'Frontend review', and currently selected unit details expanded by default.

Standardize overflow handling for long tokens (URLs, ids, hostnames): apply overflow-wrap:anywhere for paragraphs, and for chips use max-width with text-overflow:ellipsis + title tooltip on hover; avoid multi-line chip stacks that create jagged layouts.

Strengthen hierarchy within the right column cards: increase heading size/weight slightly, add clearer section dividers, and reduce repeated heavy shadows. Consider using a subtle border and less glow so content reads crisper.
Add accessible labels: aria-labels for icon-only buttons (refresh/chevron/zoom), and ensure visible focus styles (or add a focus ring class) for keyboard navigation.
Make the event strip more discoverable: increase contrast, add hover/active styling, and consider a sticky position within the flow panel so it’s not lost at the bottom.

stop_reason: Not production-worthy yet due to mobile clipping of the primary diagram, cramped/partially truncated navigation controls, and insufficient readability/contrast for key metadata. Needs responsive layout and overflow fixes before further polish.
